﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: reflections 0.9.9 -> 0.10.2

## Context

Project `gauge-java` (by getgauge) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.reflections:reflections` from `0.9.9` to `0.10.2` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/getgauge/gauge-java/pull/633

## Your Task

The source code is in `/gauge-java`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
